_comment: Upstream release digests for the tooling deploy/Dockerfile installs.
These are release checksums, not pins of a cumulative artifact, so they
live here as data rather than as sha256 literals in test source (which
pipeline/pin_guard.py flags): a checksum only ever changes together with
the version it belongs to, in the same commit, in the same file.
Refresh every entry from the upstream release page when bumping a version.
